args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and error rate at 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback performed.

transcript.content:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and error rate at 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback performed.
